items.title: Nancy Wilson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I was also on the education, when Lyndon Johnson appointed me.

ctx.x: You were what I might describe as a quiet activist. I don’t think many people are aware of all the behind-the-scenes things that you did. How did you come to be a member of the Minority Business Advisory Council under the Nixon administration?

Nixon appointed me. Don’t ask me why. I was also on the education, when Lyndon Johnson appointed me. And I didn’t do anything to work at it. It just was offered. It was there. I guess they thought I might be too quiet, and they found out I wasn’t.
What was involved in these things?
